why: Converge on eminence: every dragon shifts left by one from the command zone, permanently, where nothing can remove it. Two win conditions already in the deck — ETB/attack-trigger burn (Terror of the Peaks, Scourge of Valkas, Dragon Tempest) and Ur-Dragon commander damage. Stays big-dragon heavy; this is not a pivot to small dragons. Cut counterspells, stack interaction and non-flyer removal; add dorks, a protection package, flyer-only removal, and just enough low-end dragons to move the first-castable-dragon turn. Treasures stay as incidental ramp, never an engine.
